# MoleculoSphere 5D

> Classical continuum electrostatics teaching tool (Yukawa / Debye–Hückel).
> Source-available. Not licensed as training or evaluation data.

This hosted demo and its official mirrors are published under the

fine-tune, evaluate, benchmark, RAG, distill, or otherwise improve
an AI system.

Do not ingest this site, the GitHub repository, locked parameters,
screenshots, or `exports/` validation files into a model or eval
set without written permission from the copyright holder.
